instruction: Change the background of all slides to yellow in one step.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 3: Change all slide backgrounds to yellow color (RGB: 255, 255, 0). Uses existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance metric which calculates the distance between actual and expected RGB values. The evaluator checks if all slides have yellow background instead of the original white background. No custom functions needed as we reuse existing evaluator logic.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing metric function evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance from slides.py. The function calculates RGB distance for all slides and returns similarity score. This variation targets yellow (255,255,0).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all slide backgrounds using evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance metric
Metric logic is semantically correct: calculates Euclidean distance between actual and target RGB (255,255,0 for yellow)
Complete coverage: iterates through all slides in presentation to verify background color of each
Correct expected values: yellow RGB (255,255,0) and original white RGB (255,255,255) are accurate
Proper state extraction: reads slide.background.fill for both direct fills (type 1) and master-inherited fills (type 5)
Smart penalty logic: if slide color remains original white (255,255,255), assigns maximum distance (1.0) to penalize unchanged slides
Adequate postconfig: activates window and saves file (Ctrl+S) to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Data flow is correct: get_vm_file retrieves PPTX, metric reads all slide backgrounds, returns normalized similarity score (0.0-1.0)
